objective: R40 lifecycle-safety hardening after deep line-level audit

confirmedFindings.finding: R39 tray Full Exit called ExitAll(0) directly without verified owned-runtime cleanup.
confirmedFindings.fix: ExitCleanly invokes fail-closed cleanup and exits only after cleanup exit 0.

confirmedFindings.finding: R39 UI update install path did not independently reject active/stale FreeNetHub-owned runtime before installer launch.
confirmedFindings.fix: UI and Prepare-Upgrade now fail closed on active/unverifiable Gateway/Direct-DPI/runtime state.

confirmedFindings.finding: Gateway apply/stop had best-effort cleanup branches that could return after silent rollback failure.
confirmedFindings.fix: Critical rollback removals/restores are verified and fail closed on residue.

confirmedFindings.finding: Unparseable local/remote revision could previously be treated as update-available.
confirmedFindings.fix: Revision comparison now requires parseable positive local and remote revisions and selects highest revisioned installer asset.

confirmedFindings.finding: Linux close/shutdown lifecycle lacked explicit hide-on-close plus owned-runtime cleanup on real shutdown/signals.
confirmedFindings.fix: Close hides; shutdown/SIGTERM/SIGINT invokes browser and console cleanup.

confirmedFindings.finding: Updater asset discovery accepted any FreeNetHub_*.exe, so an unrelated higher-revision diagnostic/tool executable could outrank the installer.
confirmedFindings.fix: Only FreeNetHub_*_Setup.exe assets are eligible; dedicated regression proves a hypothetical R99 diagnostic is ignored in favor of R40 Setup.

confirmedFindings.finding: During startup Inventory/NodeRefresh work, Closing evaluated Task before ShellHosted tray behavior; first X only cancelled work and left the window visible.
confirmedFindings.fix: ShellHosted Closing is evaluated first and sets WindowState=Minimized; Shell timer hides it to tray. Exact-installed live diagnostic: iconic at 100ms, hidden by 250ms, shell/child alive through 4s, second launch restores same instance.

confirmedFindings.finding: Cleanup only in GTK shutdown callback could not veto a user/signal exit if cleanup failed.
confirmedFindings.fix: Explicit Full Exit/SIGTERM/SIGINT now runs browser+console cleanup in a worker and calls quit only after aggregate PASS; failure presents UI and keeps app alive. Shutdown callback remains fallback.

validation.pytest: 181/181 PASS on final local source candidate
validation.windowsCloseToTray: PASS hidden by 250ms; shell+child remain alive; second launch restores same instance
validation.windowsFullExitCleanup: PASS; zero project listeners/TUN/Gateway owner/Direct-DPI residue
validation.windowsUpdateDowngradeGuard: PASS local R40 vs public R39 => updateAvailable=false

failuresAndPrevention.rootCause: Initial R13 package builder renamed package/manifest but source install.sh and legacy runtime VERSION still embedded R12 metadata.
failuresAndPrevention.prevention: R13 builder now asserts expected version in both runtime modules and exact version/release markers in install.sh before packaging.

failuresAndPrevention.rootCause: Hosted CI checkout normalized RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE.json to LF while standalone MANIFEST raw sha256 was generated from Windows CRLF bytes.
failuresAndPrevention.prevention: Standalone MANIFEST now records raw runtime sha256 plus canonical Git sourceSha256; public-tree CI verifies sourceSha256 while installed integrity retains raw sha256.

failuresAndPrevention.rootCause: Closing handler checked active Task/Gateway before ShellHosted behavior, so startup Inventory caused X to cancel work instead of minimizing. A first attempted direct Hide inside Closing destroyed the WPF child and was rejected.
failuresAndPrevention.prevention: ShellHosted branch now precedes Task/Gateway and uses WindowState=Minimized; shell timer performs HideToTray. Live WM_CLOSE interval diagnostic is required for regression.
